# ALIF AI Repository Instructions

- Use Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
- Keep all AI provider API keys in server-only environment variables.
- Validate API request bodies with Zod.
- Stream provider responses through server route handlers.
- Never execute arbitrary uploaded code or plugin code on the server.
- Require explicit approval for external, destructive or sensitive agent operations.
- Use Prisma models in `prisma/schema.prisma` for persistent data.
- Write source code, variable names and comments in professional English.
- Explain implementation summaries in Bengali.
